requirements.title: All of a customer's data erased at the end of its service
requirements.statement: Once the retrieval period of a completed switch has expired, or when the customer decides it, and after the return export where the customer chose one, the data rights element shall erase all of the customer's exportable data, digital assets and personal data, with every copy in the database, the document store, the identity provider accounts and the host logs, leaving the backups to their rotation and keeping only the items that the agreed list of legal obligations names.
requirements.rationale: Data Act Art. 25(2)(h) and 25(3)(c) and GDPR Art. 28(3)(g) end in the same erasure of the tenant, decided by one measure; the backups are erased by their rotation (EL-BACKUPSTORE).
